segments.name: Regulated Water
segments.description: Provides regulated water and wastewater utility services to residential, commercial, industrial and fire protection customers across eight states.
segments.evidence: The Regulated Water segment is comprised of eight operating segments for the Company's water and wastewater regulated utility companies, aligned with the states where we provide these services.

segments.name: Regulated Natural Gas
segments.description: Provides regulated natural gas distribution services to residential, commercial, industrial and transportation customers in western Pennsylvania and Kentucky.
segments.evidence: The Regulated Natural Gas segment is comprised of one operating segment representing natural gas utility companies, for which the Company provides natural gas distribution services.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Holds the company's non-regulated water, wastewater and natural gas operations that are not quantitatively significant enough to be reportable.
segments.evidence: These businesses represent its non-regulated water, wastewater, and natural gas operations, which are not quantitatively significant to be reportable and therefore are included as a component of "Other".

revenueModel.text: The company earns regulated tariffs from metered residential, commercial, industrial and other utility customers for water, wastewater and natural gas consumption, plus market-based fees from non-regulated services.
revenueModel.evidence: Substantially all of our water utility customers are metered, which allows us to measure and bill for our customers' water consumption.

changes.text: In 2024, the company sold its interest in three non-utility local microgrid and distributed energy projects.
changes.evidence: During the first quarter of 2024, the Company completed the sale of its interest in three non-utility local microgrid and distributed energy projects and recognized a gain of $91,236.
